visual.detailed_description: Single grayscale coronal view of the abdomen and pelvis on a black background. A large dark-gray crescent-shaped region surrounds much of a bright kidney-shaped structure in the image-right upper-middle area. A red arrow enters from the right and points up-left toward the outer edge of that region. Bowel loops and central branching bright vessels lie to the left, with bright pelvic bones and a rounded bladder-shaped region below. A boxed A is visible near the lower-right, consistent with an imaging orientation annotation; it is not treated as a panel label. No ruler, lesion dimensions or chart axes are printed.
